descriptionMarkdown:
Ogryn Role Feature
Bulwark
Allies benefiting from cover 
provided by your slab shield have 
advantage on Dexterity saving 
throws against Blast and Spray 
effects, and ignore the first 5 ft of 
forced movement they would 
suffer each round.
Gun Lugger
You ignore disadvantage from 
firing Heavy or Ogryn weapons 
after moving.
Bone ’ead
Once per long rest, treat a failed 
Wisdom or Intelligence saving 
throw as a success.
Brute
Once per turn, when you push or 
knock a creature prone, deal 
bludgeoning damage equal to your 
Strength modifier.
